description: This file contains extension methods for authorization services related to content types in OrchardCore, including permission checks and owner variation logic.

classes.name: AuthorizationServiceExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for IAuthorizationService to handle content type authorization with owner variations.

methods.name: AuthorizeContentTypeAsync
methods.description: Checks if a user is authorized for a specific content type and owner.

methods.name: AuthorizeContentTypeAsync
methods.description: Checks if a user is authorized for a content type by name and owner.

methods.name: AuthorizeContentTypeDefinitionsAsync
methods.description: Evaluates if a user has owner variation permissions for at least one content type in a collection.

methods.name: GetOwnerVariation
methods.description: Returns the owner-specific variation of a given permission if applicable.
